title: Improving the Resolution of GRACE Data for Spatio-Temporal Groundwater Storage Assessment
datasets: ESA CCI or GLDAS soil-moisture product

dataset_roles.dataset: ESA CCI or GLDAS soil-moisture product

idea.research_question: How do GRACE storage, precipitation and soil moisture jointly improve regional groundwater-storage downscaling?
idea.hypothesis: The joint signal should explain variation that cannot be identified from any single required dataset alone.
idea.mechanism: Align all required roles, construct role-specific features, test interactions and compare against single-role baselines.
idea.analytical_approach: Multisource spatial-temporal modelling with interaction, robustness and ablation analysis
idea.expected_contribution: A benchmark task grounded in an independently audited full-text seed paper.
idea.falsification_condition: Reject if any required role is absent, background-only, or not operationally used in the same research instance.
